description: This file defines classes and functions related to OAuth2 security schemes in FastAPI, including dependencies for OAuth2 password flow, bearer tokens, and OAuth2 authorization code flow. It provides mechanisms for handling OAuth2 authentication methods and scope management within a FastAPI application.

classes.name: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm
classes.description: A dependency class to collect OAuth2 username and password from form data for password flow authentication.

classes.name: OAuth2PasswordRequestFormStrict
classes.description: A stricter version of OAuth2PasswordRequestForm that enforces the 'grant_type' field to be 'password'.

classes.name: OAuth2
classes.description: Base class for OAuth2 authentication schemes, used as a dependency and extended by specific flow classes.

classes.name: OAuth2PasswordBearer
classes.description: OAuth2 flow for authentication using a password obtained with a bearer token; used as a dependency.

classes.name: OAuth2AuthorizationCodeBearer
classes.description: OAuth2 flow for authentication using a bearer token obtained via an OAuth2 authorization code flow; used as a dependency.

classes.name: SecurityScopes
classes.description: A class to collect and manage OAuth2 scopes required by dependencies in a chain, supporting scope aggregation across multiple dependencies.

methods.name: HTTPException make_not_authenticated_error(self)
methods.description: Generates an HTTPException indicating the user is not authenticated, with a default 'Bearer' challenge.

methods.name: Optional[str] __call__(self, request: Request)
methods.description: Async method to extract the authorization token from the request headers and validate the scheme.
